---
description: Set up artgen in this game repo (art/ scaffold) and show the art-pipeline status
---
Run `node tools/artgen/artgen.js init` in the repo root, then `node tools/artgen/artgen.js direction show`. Summarise what exists (locked direction,
candidates, probes, assets) and the next step: if no direction is locked, offer to start the art direction workflow
(art-direction skill).
